title: Alhambra with Rabi
text: Hobby was a very good tour, guide excellent and knowledge and knows a lot about everything. The pace was very nice and he paused when we ask questions great tour guide you must have him.
author: Lori_C

title: A breathtaking tour
text: Beautiful experience, the guide Dinko very prepared. He passed on all his passion and the beauty of the Alhambra throughout the tour, explaining every detail very well.
author: Claudia_A

title: There's a lot to walk around...
text: There's a lot to walk, but it's worth it.  Bring your water bottle so you can refill it along the way.
author: Jose_A

title: BEST TOUR GUIDE EVER
text: This was the best tour and tour guide I have ever taken! Hands down. I have taken plenty of tours across Europe but none were as thorough and knowledgeable. Beyond the fact that he gave us a private tour and went above and beyond to make it happen, he is a beacon of knowledge. Our tour guide Rabi knew so much about the history and nuances of the art and design. MOST HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! If you are Arabic speaking or have Arabic speaking members in your group he can go between languages which is beyond great.
